name: runbook_search
description: Search documentation backends for runbooks, RFCs, postmortems, and operational knowledge. Vendor-neutral across Confluence, Notion, Sphinx/MkDocs, and Atlassian Developer Docs.
usage_guidance: Use this tool BEFORE proposing any operational action — to find an existing runbook — and AFTER documenting an action — to verify the new doc is indexed and discoverable. Supports four actions: `search` (full-text query), `get` (fetch one doc by ID/URL), `list_by_label` (browse by tag/label), and `recent` (most recently updated docs in a space). Always pass --limit to bound result size. Title-only matches rank above body-only matches by default.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.description: Search query. For `search`, supports the backend's native query syntax (CQL for Confluence, full-text for Notion/Atlassian Docs). Required for search.

parameters.name: --space
parameters.description: Confluence space key, Notion database ID, or docs-site section. Optional; if omitted, searches all visible spaces.

parameters.name: --label
parameters.description: Tag/label filter. For `list_by_label` it is required; for `search` it is an additional filter.

parameters.name: --id
parameters.description: Document ID or URL. Required for `get`.

parameters.name: --types
parameters.description: Comma-separated content types to include (Atlassian Docs only): developer_docs, app_documentation, knowledge_base, community_content. Defaults to all.

parameters.name: --limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return.

parameters.name: --include_body
parameters.description: Include the full document body in results (large payloads). Default returns title + URL + snippet only.

parameters.name: --provider
parameters.description: Documentation backend. Auto-detected from --endpoint URL or DOCS_BACKEND env var. Defaults to 'atlassian_docs' (Rovo Dev's purpose-built docs search).

parameters.name: --endpoint
parameters.description: Backend API base URL. Required for confluence/notion/mkdocs. Ignored for atlassian_docs (uses internal MCP).

parameters.name: --dry_run
parameters.description: Validate parameters and print the resolved request without contacting the backend.

preflight_checks.fix: Verify CONFLUENCE_URL / NOTION_TOKEN are set; check VPN if backend is internal-only.

resource_cost: Low. Each search is a single HTTP call; result size capped by --limit.
rate_limits: Confluence: 5000/hr/user. Notion: 3 req/sec. Atlassian Docs: shared MCP rate limit.

expected_response_schema.data: object — {results: [{id, title, url, space, labels, snippet, last_updated, body?}, ...]}
